test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Identify the preposition that needs to be omitted to correct the sentence.

They live near to the park.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. to .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is incorrect because the preposition **'to'** is r
